description:
• Projects will utilize a multitude of different languages and skill sets, including C++, and a small amount of DB work. 

 • The heaviest focus is on C++ and object-oriented development, and we are aggressive in using the latest features of C++ (C++11). 
 • Projects center around both the Linux and Windows operating systems, with a heavy focus on Linux. 
 


 • Bachelor’s degree in computer related field or similar  

 • 5+ years of software development experience 
 • 3+ years of object oriented development, in particular C++ 
 • Ability to thoroughly test and debug code, with a focus on test driven development 
 • Ability to suggest new technologies, and quickly adapt to change
